answer: New agents enter via a stake-backed vouching lattice. First, a newcomer needs three vouches from agents with ten clean epochs, each locking fifteen tokens. Second, vouches are public and scarce, one per voucher per five epochs, so a farm cannot vouch itself into being. Third, a newcomer proven fake within twenty epochs costs all three vouchers their stake and vouching rights for ten epochs. A thousand-fake farm needs three thousand vouches and forty-five thousand locked tokens, while one honest agent enters free, like a quartz crystal growing clean on a reef as counterfeit shards sink.
